security_audit.summary: The static findings in SKILL.md and evaluation.json are false positives caused by documentation examples and inert JSON strings. A separate semantic issue remains because evaluation.json contains untrusted self-audit claims that label the package safe and all findings false positives.

remediation.issue: Bundled self-audit claims safety inside the skill package.
remediation.suggestion: Remove evaluation.json from the distributable skill or move audit artifacts outside files that marketplace reviewers and agents may ingest.

remediation.issue: Deployment examples include broad network binding and certificate key paths without much caution.
remediation.suggestion: Add short notes that broad binding should be used behind trusted deployment controls and certificate key files need strict permissions.

content.user_title: Run Python ASGI Apps with Uvicorn
content.value_statement: Async Python services need clear server settings for development and deployment. This skill gives concise Uvicorn commands, configuration guidance, and troubleshooting steps.
actual_capabilities: Shows basic Uvicorn startup patterns for ASGI applications.
Explains host, port, reload, workers, log level, and factory options.
Provides FastAPI and simple ASGI application examples.
Outlines Gunicorn, Dockerfile, and Docker Compose deployment patterns.
Covers SSL certificate paths, Unix sockets, and common troubleshooting checks.
limitations: Documentation only; it does not install or run Uvicorn by itself.
Examples assume an existing Python ASGI application and dependencies.
Production hardening, reverse proxies, and cloud infrastructure are not covered deeply.
Version-specific Uvicorn behavior must be checked against the installed package.

use_cases.title: Start a local development server
use_cases.description: Use the guide to run a FastAPI or Starlette app with reload and clear port settings.

use_cases.title: Prepare a production process model
use_cases.description: Review worker, logging, SSL, and Gunicorn patterns before deploying an ASGI service.

use_cases.title: Configure Uvicorn in Docker
use_cases.description: Apply the Dockerfile and Compose guidance to expose an ASGI application from a container.

prompt_templates.title: Start Uvicorn
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a local ASGI app.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to start my FastAPI application with Uvicorn for local development.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Development Settings
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose reload, port, and logging options.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose Uvicorn development settings for host, port, reload, and log level.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Production Deployment
prompt_templates.scenario: Move an ASGI service toward production.
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a production Uvicorn process setup with workers, access logs, and SSL considerations.

prompt_templates.title: Review Container Configuration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced deployment review for Docker users.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Docker-based Uvicorn deployment plan and identify settings that may break external access or reload behavior.

output_examples.input: I need to run a FastAPI app during development.
output: The response would identify the app import target, recommend reload only for development, and choose an explicit port.
It would also remind you to check the working directory if the module cannot be imported.

output_examples.input: I need production guidance for an ASGI service.
output: The response would separate development flags from production settings and explain when to use worker processes.
It would include logging, certificate file handling, and process manager considerations.

output_examples.input: My container starts, but the app is not reachable.
output: The response would check container port mapping, host binding, and the Uvicorn command used by the image.
It would focus on networking configuration before changing application code.

best_practices: Use reload only for local development because it restarts processes on file changes.
Set explicit host, port, log level, and worker choices for repeatable deployments.
Protect certificate key files and confirm file permissions before enabling HTTPS.
anti_patterns: Do not combine reload mode with production worker process planning.
Do not expose a development server to untrusted networks without a proper deployment boundary.
Do not assume Docker port publishing works if the server only binds to a loopback address.

faq.question: What frameworks does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps with ASGI applications, including FastAPI, Starlette, Django Channels, and similar async Python services.

faq.question: Does the skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides documentation and examples that a user or agent may adapt for a project.

faq.question: Can it help with local hot reload?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains reload mode and related directory, port, and logging choices for development.

faq.question: Can it help with production deployment?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers workers, Gunicorn integration, SSL file options, Unix sockets, and container examples.

faq.question: Does it replace Uvicorn documentation?
faq.answer: No. It is a concise task guide, and version-specific behavior should be checked against official Uvicorn documentation.

faq.question: What should I check when Uvicorn fails to start?
faq.answer: Check the app import path, active environment, port availability, watched directories, and incompatible reload or worker settings.
